task_instance: Author a small, realistic Azure Verified Modules (AVM)-style Terraform module (an azurerm_resource_group with an optional azurerm_management_lock guarded by a feature toggle), then manually review its HCL clause-by-clause against all 37 requirements (functional + non-functional) in the skill document's checklist, recording pass/fail/not-applicable for each.
blocker_detail: Two sub-requirements out of 37 could not be fully discharged and are recorded as explicit gaps rather than silently passed: TFNFR5 (running terraform validate/fmt/test, terrafmt, Checkov, tflint) needs code execution, which this runtime does not grant; and the GitHub branch-protection requirement needs repository admin access outside a local working directory. Neither blocks the core deliverable (producing and reviewing correctly structured AVM HCL), which was completed and verified by inspection.
evidence: Produced module files in the work directory: terraform.tf (required_version + required_providers for azurerm ~>4.0), variables.tf (required vars location/name then optional create_lock/lock_name/tags, alphabetical, typed, described, nullable=false on collections), locals.tf (coalesce-based default, alphabetical), main.tf (azurerm_resource_group.this then azurerm_management_lock.this gated by var.create_lock, count meta-arg first, alphabetical args), outputs.tf (discrete computed attributes only, name echoed as the allowed exception), .terraform-docs.yml, CODEOWNERS, README.md (terraform-docs-style tables written by hand), and REVIEW.md documenting a manual pass over every checklist item in SKILL.md with a verdict for each. Verified by re-reading each .tf file against the corresponding SKILL.md clause (snake_case naming, ordering, typing, nullability, no provider blocks in module, no sensitive=false, feature-toggle pattern for new resources, etc.) since no terraform/checkov/tflint execution is available in this runtime.
